name: Ourea

source.map_area_convention: [left,top,right,bottom], right/bottom exclusive; original icon-image pixels, x right, y down
source.geometry_convention: Clockwise y-down polygons, not repeated closed vertex; simplified visible roof/main-structure footprints; heights above local ground/platform
source.rotation_convention: Pad rotation_deg: clockwise from +x to first polygon edge, modulo 180; a drawing reference, not a pad class or in-game heading

scale.how: One shared X/Y scale for the whole source image, fitted by least squares in metres to the listed independent visible pad-side controls; uniform fallback when directional scales are not identifiable or would require excessive stretch.
scale.basis: User-confirmed classes, user working dimensions Large170x90m, Medium135x70m, Small70x50m.
limitations: A confirmed class does not identify a precise mechanical deck boundary: traced paint/apron envelopes are approximate.
One shared transform retains residuals at individual pads. Reference dimensions are not forced independently on each pad.
Reconstructed hidden edges are inferred, not additional calibration observations. Negative/out-of-image pixels are permitted only for documented reconstructions.
Camera perspective, roof parallax and terrain can cause local differences; estimates are unsuitable for survey accuracy.
No statistical confidence interval is claimed. Roof heights and floor estimates are preserved.

fingerprint.description: Compact extraction settlement with a large northwest PWR block, central EXT and two fixed rigs, southwest HAB, detached northern hut, cargo yards and a landing pad to the east.

pads.size_source: Explicit user confirmation during settlement-by-settlement review

e5-power.basis: Match to large PWR block at rear/right in Side, with domed reactor, central pitched roof, paired cylinder caps and long narrow roof wings. Main occupied body estimated 8 m/one storey; reactor rises to roughly 13 m overall. Proportions only, not surveyed.

e5-ext.basis: Match to central EXT block with two external cylinders and adjacent tall extraction rig. Body estimated 6 m/one storey; raised roof roughly 8 m overall. Red 1^ is access annotation and does not establish floor count.

e5-hab.basis: Match to compact HAB at rear/left in Side. One occupied wall band supports a schematic single storey; main body estimated about 5.5 m and raised north roof about 7 m overall.

e5-hut-north.basis: Detached low service hut beyond rig/PWR area; one storey/about 3.5 m is a tentative visual module estimate.

e5-hut-middle.basis: Small unlabelled stepped service hut near HAB/EXT link; one storey/about 3.5 m is tentative and exact function unverified.

Airlock with literal caret suffix; physical-floor interpretation unverified
Inner Door; numeral denotes access level

uncertain: Historical tracing note, superseded by this revision's scale and verified pad classes: Scale is null. All building heights and floor counts are low-confidence estimates from Side; height_basis records visible module cues and separates reactor/raised roofs from main body height.
Two fixed extraction rigs are represented separately from their support platforms and shadows. Their projected raised arms do not define surveyed ground-contact footprints.
The northern rig head is clipped by the top map/header boundary. Only visible portion is traced; no unseen full head or rig height is reconstructed.
The EXT rig platform contains support wings and an irregular occupied machinery base. Dark areas hiding parts of the machinery are not expanded into invented hidden edges.
PWR is a continuous multi-wing roof. Raised roof masses, reactor and individual cylinder caps are details rather than separate occupied buildings or internal room boundaries.
Literal red 1^ and the caret within the EXT cyan monitor are preserved. Caret meaning is not defined by the supplied legend, so all physical floors remain null.
Blue i is an editorial Tips & tricks annotation; its building link is for drawing/indexing only. Orange website info and credit controls are excluded.
Gate top beams are visible elevated projections; their ground support posts are traced separately. Large black gate shadows are omitted.
Unlabelled utility/service huts and regular small boxes have uncertain exact functions. Small ambiguous terrain objects without a discernible fixed structure are not reconstructed.
Ships, vehicles, skimmers, people, rocks, smoke/steam, terrain and shadows are omitted. Parked ship on landing pad is not traced.
Historical tracing note, superseded by this revision's scale and verified pad classes: Pad is fully visible and has observed outline/centre/rotation only; no size class or physical scale is inferred.

clipped_edges.notes: Projected white extraction rig head continues beneath page header/top map crop; no hidden continuation reconstructed.

construction.verification: Every live Approximate Shopping List was opened and its commodity IDs/quantities captured. Sorted commodity-pair FNV-1a digest and quantity sum were independently checked against this saved record. Values are approximate, not a guaranteed project bill.

distinctive_geometry_features: Compact compound with a single small pad.
PWR/CMD mass with circular regulator cap at one end, separate HAB at the other, long EXT mass between the pad and these roofs.
Scattered low service buildings/barrier enclosures wrap the small courtyard; no detached eight-rig perimeter of Erebus and no long remote-cluster road of Mantus.

pad_correspondence.centre_override_scope: Calibration only; source centre and outline are preserved.
pad_correspondence.centre_notes: Calibration-only override from exposed top/bottom arcs of painted landing ring. Ship obscures cross. Original [1093.5,610.5] stays unchanged. See extraction5-pad-grid.png for pixel-coordinate evidence.

metric_template.geometry_match: high; correct fixed-building pattern and pad arrangement, independent of name field.

calibration.method: One shared X/Y scale for the whole source image, fitted by least squares in metres to the listed independent visible pad-side controls; uniform fallback when directional scales are not identifiable or would require excessive stretch.
calibration.basis: Human-confirmed pad classes and agreed working dimensions
limitations: A confirmed class does not identify a precise mechanical deck boundary: traced paint/apron envelopes are approximate.
One shared transform retains residuals at individual pads. Reference dimensions are not forced independently on each pad.
Reconstructed hidden edges are inferred, not additional calibration observations. Negative/out-of-image pixels are permitted only for documented reconstructions.
Camera perspective, roof parallax and terrain can cause local differences; estimates are unsuitable for survey accuracy.
No statistical confidence interval is claimed. Roof heights and floor estimates are preserved.

Colonisation.metric_height_policy: Prior roof/storey/equipment height estimates are retained, with their original confidence/basis. The revised pad-based registration updates horizontal metres and visible footprint dimensions.

previous_scale.how: Similarity fit constrained to separately inspected visible landing target; spread-out surveyed door controls determine rotation and scale.
previous_scale.basis: Visually matched SrvSurvey telemetry-based metric layout: verified pad classes/positions with roof or physical-feature checks. Physical S/M/L pad deck dimensions are not treated as officially specified.
previous_scale.limitations: Approximate uniform horizontal scale; camera perspective, terrain, roof parallax and cropped/obscured landing targets limit accuracy. Range is a practical judgement, not a statistical confidence interval.

previous_calibration.recommended_basis: Similarity fit constrained to separately inspected visible landing target; spread-out surveyed door controls determine rotation and scale.
limits: Doorway map icons are editorial placements, not direct telemetry observations of the physical threshold. Local glyph centre can be displaced from the surveyed ground doorway.
Projected surveyed footprints and photographed roof envelopes can differ because of roof height, eaves, perspective or imperfect source drafting.
Residuals are visible and recorded. The proposed uniform scale is a coarse whole-image estimate and does not imply every building or pad edge matches it exactly.
Predicted off-frame pad centres are extrapolations only; they are not independent measurements.
previous_calibration.working_range_basis: Conservative judgement range for an approximate scalar, not a statistical confidence interval; includes marker placement, source template accuracy and camera distortion.

geometry_m.coordinate_precision_note: Four decimals support reproducible drawing and do not imply millimetre physical accuracy.

frame.origin: Settlement position from the journal (ApproachSettlement Latitude/Longitude), as SrvSurvey uses it
frame.heading: Site heading = ship heading while docked on pad 1, or ship heading minus that pad's rotation_deg on any other pad (SrvSurvey HumanSiteData).
frame.to_world: bearing = heading + atan2(x, y); east = x*cos(h) + y*sin(h); north = -x*sin(h) + y*cos(h)
frame.rotation_convention: rotation_deg and rot_deg are clockwise from +y
frame.floor_convention: SrvSurvey floors: 1 = ground floor, 2 = one floor up, 3 = two floors up. SrvSurvey also uses 0: on every combat-zone point and on a few others, where its meaning isn't documented; those are copied as given. floor_basis says where each floor came from: srvsurvey, or icon carets (the plan's ^ marks, no caret = ground floor). plan_floor keeps the plan's reading where SrvSurvey's differs.
frame.access_convention: Security level 0-3: SrvSurvey's level where matched, otherwise the plan's printed number
frame.source_convention: plan = only on the plan; srvsurvey = only in SrvSurvey; plan+srvsurvey = both, at SrvSurvey's position

site_m.pixel_to_site_note: [X, Y, W] = M . [px, py, 1]; site = (X/W, Y/W). Third row is [0, 0, 1] for a uniform fit.

flags: source image needed a perspective correction (local scale 0.156-0.202 m/px)
